Eden linux AppImage / windows zip / macOS dmg install entries
eden:Eden:Nintendo Switch:keys / :firmware rules bound to manual:nintendo-switch-keys and manual:nintendo-switch-firmware

paths.path: ~/.config/eden/qt-config.ini (ConfigDir = $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eden, default ~/.config/eden; a portable user/ dir next to the AppImage binary takes priority) — controller mappings live in its [Controls] section; named input profiles are separate ini files at ~/.config/eden/input/<profile>.ini; the SDL frontend keeps its own sdl2-config.ini in the same config dir
evidence: source:src/common/fs/path_util.cpp POSIX branch — portable user/ dir wins, else GetDataDirectory("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") / EDEN_DIR (fallback home/.config)
source:src/frontend_common/config.cpp — BeginGroup/WriteCategory(Settings::Category::Controls) i.e. the [Controls] ini section; "sdl2-config.ini" in ConfigDir
docs:git.eden-emu.dev docs/user/Multiplayer.md and GyroControls.md — instruct users to edit the qt-config.ini file directly

paths.path: ~/.local/share/eden/nand/user/save/ ($XDG_DATA_HOME/eden/nand/user/save) — account saves at account/<128-bit user UUID hex>/<title id upper 16 hex>/0/, device saves at device/<title id 16 hex>/0/; SD card game data sits separately in ~/.local/share/eden/sdmc
paths.naming: Per-game directories keyed by Switch title id inside the NAND user save space (EmuPath::SaveDir aliases the NAND dir)
evidence: source:src/core/file_sys/savedata_factory.cpp — fmt::format("{}/account/{}/{:016X}/0", space_id_path, uuid.RawString(), title_id) with space_id_path "/user/save"; device variant "{}/device/{:016X}/0"; account root "/user/save/account/{}"
source:src/common/fs/path_util.cpp — GenerateEdenPath(EdenPath::SaveDir, eden_path / NAND_DIR); NANDDir = XDG_DATA_HOME / EDEN_DIR / "nand"

paths.path: ~/.local/share/eden/keys/prod.keys plus optional title.keys (KeysDir = data root / "keys"); eden also reads prod.keys_autogenerated / title.keys_autogenerated and dev.keys in the same directory
evidence: source:src/core/crypto/key_manager.cpp — LoadFromFile(keys_dir / "prod.keys"), LoadFromFile(keys_dir / "title.keys"), *_autogenerated variants, HasKeys() checking prod.keys/title.keys existence

paths.path: Switch firmware is NCA content installed into the NAND system partition: ~/.local/share/eden/nand/system/Contents/registered/ (user-partition mirror at nand/user/Contents/registered); Lunchbox installs dumps from manual:nintendo-switch-firmware into Eden's active NAND profile
evidence: db:sources/firmware-rules.json — eden:Eden:Nintendo Switch:firmware rule ("installs it into Eden's active NAND profile") and eden:Eden:Nintendo Switch:keys rule (prod.keys + optional title.keys)

linux.notes: No save-state feature: fs_paths.h defines no states directory and src/core has no savestate module at commit c95ad020fb (purpose 'states' therefore omitted). Eden defines legacy EmuPath roots for citron/sudachi/yuzu/suyu (XDG data dirs) and Ryujinx (config dir on UNIX) for cross-emulator migration, but Eden's own layout is plain ~/.local/share/eden, ~/.config/eden, ~/.cache/eden. The Lunchbox AppImage source (eden-linux clang pgo asset) runs Eden with HOME/XDG pointing at the Lunchbox data root.

paths.path: ~/.config/eden/qt-config.ini with [Controls] mappings and ~/.config/eden/input/<profile>.ini profiles — macOS shares the POSIX branch, and unset XDG_* vars fall back to home/.config (no bundle-local data dir)
evidence: source:src/common/fs/path_util.cpp — POSIX (#else) branch applies to __APPLE__; GetDataDirectory falls back to GetHomeDirectory() / ".config" when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is unset

paths.path: ~/.local/share/eden/nand/user/save/ (account/<uuid>/<title id>/0/, device/<title id>/0/); SD card data in ~/.local/share/eden/sdmc
paths.naming: Per-game directories keyed by Switch title id inside the NAND user save space

macos.notes: macOS builds ship as aarch64 dmg assets on git.eden-emu.dev releases (Lunchbox install source); paths are the plain XDG defaults because the code has no macOS-specific data root.
